summary: EDAP TMS S.A. (FocalTherics) filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten public offering of 8,425,000 ADSs at $4.75 per ADS, representing ordinary shares, for gross proceeds of approximately $40.0 million. The ADSs trade on Nasdaq under FOCL, formerly EDAP. Underwriters have a 30-day option for 1,263,750 additional ADSs. Joint book-runners are TD Cowen and Mizuho; co-managers H.C. Wainwright and Lucid. Settlement is T+2 on/about August 14, 2026. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
